title: Gelecek
canDo: Gelecek hakkında tahminlerde bulunabilir, ne kadar emin olduğumu belirtebilir, anlık kararlar verip yardım teklif edebilir ve çevreyle ilgili basit görüşlerimi paylaşabilirim.
grammar: Will ...? ve I think / I don't think ... will

liveClass.title: 2050 yılında dünya
liveClass.goal: Gruplar 2050 yılı için bir konu seçer (şehirler, iş hayatı, okul, çevre) ve will / won't / might ile 5 tahmin hazırlar. Sınıfa sunarlar; diğer öğrenciler I agree / I don't think so ile tepki verir ve her tahmin için 'kesinlik ölçeği'nde oylama yapılır.

vocabulary.example: Climate change is a big problem.
Air pollution is bad in big cities.
Don't leave rubbish on the beach.
There's too much plastic in the sea.
Most people will drive electric cars.
We need to save the forests.
There was a drought last summer.
I think it will rain tomorrow.
I promise I won't tell anyone.

lessons.title: Bence olacak
lessons.goal: will ile gelecek hakkında tahminlerde bulunabilirim.

discover.title: Gelecekte şehirler
discover.body:
What will cities look like in 2050? Experts have some ideas.

More people will live in cities. Today about 55% of people live in cities, but in 2050 it will probably be about 70%.

Most cars will be electric, and some will drive themselves. There will be more parks and gardens on buildings, because they help keep cities cool.

People will probably work from home more often. And robots will deliver our shopping!

questions.prompt: How many people will live in cities in 2050?
Why will there be gardens on buildings?

learn.explanation:
**will** + yalın fiil → gelecek hakkında **tahmin** (bir görüşe ya da bilgiye dayalı)

| | |
|---|---|
| I / You / He / She / It / We / They **will** ('ll) | live |

- People **will** live longer.
- It**'ll** be hot tomorrow.
- There **will be** more robots.

will her özneyle aynıdır: she will (~~she wills~~), will + yalın fiil (~~will to go~~ / ~~will goes~~).

**Tahmini yumuşatmak:**

- I **think** + will: I think it'll rain.
- **probably / definitely**: will'den **sonra** gelir → It'll **probably** rain. / She'll **definitely** win.
- **Maybe / Perhaps**: cümle başında → Maybe they'll come.

examples.en: I think robots will do a lot of jobs.
There will be more electric cars.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "-ecek" eki hem going to (plan) hem will (tahmin, karar) karşılığıdır. İngilizcede bir görüşe dayalı tahmin için will (I think it will...), gördüğümüz bir kanıta dayalı tahmin için going to (Look at the clouds, it's going to rain) daha doğaldır. "There will be" = olacak (var olacak).

practice.text: I think people ___ live on the moon one day.

practice.answer: I think cars will be electric.

practice.audioText: In the future, I think we'll eat less meat and more vegetables. Maybe we'll even eat insects!
options: Daha az et, daha çok sebze yiyeceğiz

task.prompt: 2050 yılında şehrinizin nasıl olacağını tahmin edin. En az 5 tahmin yapın; I think, probably ve There will be kullanın.
task.modelAnswer: I think Istanbul will be bigger. There will be more metro lines and fewer cars. People will probably work from home. Maybe there will be robots in restaurants. The summers will definitely be hotter.

lessons.title: Olmayacak mı?
lessons.goal: won't ve Will ...? ile olumsuz tahminler yapıp tahmin sorabilirim.

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: Professor, will we solve climate change?

lines.speaker: Professor
lines.text: I think we will, but it won't be easy. We won't stop it in ten years.

lines.speaker: Host
lines.text: Will summers get hotter in Turkey?

lines.speaker: Professor
lines.text: Yes, they will. And I don't think we'll have enough water in some cities.

lines.speaker: Professor
lines.text: Definitely. They care a lot more about the environment.

questions.prompt: Does the professor think it will be easy to solve climate change?
What problem does the professor mention for some cities?
questions.explanation: "I don't think we'll have enough water in some cities"

learn.explanation:
**Olumsuz:** will not = **won't** + yalın fiil

- It **won't** be easy.
- Prices **won't** go down.

**Soru:** Will + özne + yalın fiil?

- **Will** it rain tomorrow? – Yes, it **will**. / No, it **won't**.
- **What will** the world **be like**?
- **When will** you **know**?

**I don't think ... will** → "Bence ... -meyecek"

- **I don't think** it **will** rain. (doğal)
- I think it won't rain. (doğru ama daha az doğal)

**Kısa cevaplar:** I hope so. (Umarım.) / I hope not. (Umarım olmaz.) / I don't think so. (Sanmıyorum.)

examples.en: Will we have flying cars? – I don't think so.
Don't worry. It won't take long.

learn.turkishNote: won't'un okunuşu /wəʊnt/ olup want /wɒnt/ ile karışabilir: I won't go (gitmeyeceğim) ≠ I want to go (gitmek istiyorum). "Sanmıyorum" İngilizcede "I don't think so" ile söylenir; "I think not" eski ve resmidir.

options: I don't think it will rain.

practice.text: ___ people live on Mars one day?
What will the world ___ like in 2100?

practice.prompt: "Will it rain at the wedding?" Olmasın istiyorsunuz:

practice.explanation: I don't think + özne + will + fiil.

practice.audioText: Will we have robot teachers in the future? – I don't think so. Students will always need real teachers.
practice.prompt: Konuşan robot öğretmenler hakkında ne düşünüyor?
practice.explanation: "I don't think so. Students will always need real teachers."

accepted: It won't take long.
It won't take long
It will not take long.
It will not take long

task.prompt: JAI'ye gelecek hakkında 4 tane Will...? sorusu sorun. Sonra JAI'nin sorularına I think / I don't think / I hope so / I hope not ile cevap verin.
task.modelAnswer: Will people live longer? Will we use cash in 2040? Will robots take our jobs? Will Turkey win the World Cup? ... I hope so! ... I don't think we'll use cash. ... I hope not!

lessons.title: Belki olur
lessons.goal: might ile olasılıkları ve ne kadar emin olduğumu ifade edebilirim.

lines.speaker: Zeynep
lines.text: Are you coming to the beach on Saturday?

lines.speaker: Bulut
lines.text: I'm not sure. I might go to my parents' house.

lines.speaker: Zeynep
lines.text: The weather forecast says it might rain on Saturday anyway.

lines.speaker: Bulut
lines.text: Really? Then maybe we'll go on Sunday.

lines.speaker: Zeynep
lines.text: Sunday is better. It definitely won't rain on Sunday. It'll be sunny.

lines.speaker: Bulut
lines.text: OK, I'll probably come then. I might bring my cousin too.

questions.explanation: "I'm not sure. I might go to my parents' house."

questions.prompt: What will the weather be like on Sunday?

learn.explanation:
**might** + yalın fiil → olabilir, belki (emin değilim)

- It **might** rain. (Yağmur yağabilir.)
- I **might not** come. (Gelmeyebilirim.)

might her özneyle aynıdır ve -s, to almaz.

**Kesinlik ölçeği:**

| Kesinlik | İfade |
|---|---|
| 100% ✅ | It **will definitely** rain. |
| 80% | It**'ll probably** rain. |
| 50% | It **might** rain. / **Maybe** it'll rain. |
| 20% | It **probably won't** rain. |
| 0% ❌ | It **definitely won't** rain. |

**Dikkat:** probably / definitely olumsuz cümlede won't'tan **önce** gelir: It **probably won't** rain.

examples.en: Take an umbrella. It might rain.
I might not finish the project today.
He probably won't come. He's very busy.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "-ebilir" eki hem yetenek (can) hem olasılık (might) anlamı taşır: "Yüzebilirim" = I can swim; "Yağmur yağabilir" = It might rain. Olasılık için can değil might kullanılır: "It can rain tomorrow" yanlış anlam verir.

practice.text: I'm not sure. I ___ go to the party. (belki)
It probably ___ rain. The sky is blue. (yağmayacak)

practice.answer: We might move to Izmir next year.

practice.audioText: I might change my job next year. I'm not sure yet. But I'll definitely take a long holiday.

accepted: Take an umbrella. It might rain.
Take an umbrella. It might rain
Take an umbrella, it might rain.
Take an umbrella, it might rain
Take your umbrella. It might rain.
Take your umbrella. It might rain
practice.explanation: Take an umbrella. + It might rain.

task.prompt: Gelecek yıl hayatınızda neler olacağını kesinlik ölçeğini kullanarak anlatın: 1 definitely, 1 probably, 2 might, 1 probably won't.
task.modelAnswer: Next year I'll definitely finish my English course. I'll probably get a new job. I might move to a new flat, and I might buy a car. I probably won't travel abroad because it's expensive.

lessons.title: Ben yaparım!
lessons.goal: will ile anlık kararlar verebilir, yardım teklif edebilir ve söz verebilirim.

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: Oh no, we haven't got any bread.

lines.speaker: Kaan
lines.text: I'll go to the shop. I'll be back in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: Thanks. Oh, and the phone is ringing!

lines.speaker: Kaan
lines.text: I'll answer it. ... Hello? ... Mum, it's Aunt Sevim.

lines.speaker: Mum
lines.text: Tell her I'll call her back.

lines.speaker: Kaan
lines.text: OK. And don't worry, I won't forget the bread. I promise!

questions.prompt: What does Kaan decide to do first?

questions.explanation: "I won't forget the bread. I promise!"

learn.explanation:
**will** tahmin dışında şunlar için de kullanılır:

| Kullanım | Örnek |
|---|---|
| **Anlık karar** (konuşurken veriliyor) | The phone's ringing. – **I'll** answer it. |
| **Teklif** | **I'll** carry your bag. / **Shall I** open the window? |
| **Söz** | **I'll** call you tomorrow. / **I won't** tell anyone. |
| **Rica** | **Will** you help me, please? |

**going to ile karşılaştırın:**

- **I'm going to** buy bread. (Önceden karar verdim, planım.)
- We've got no bread? **I'll** buy some. (Şu an karar verdim.)

**Shall I / Shall we** (öneri, teklif): **Shall I** help you? / **Shall we** go?

examples.en: It's cold in here. – I'll close the window.
Shall I carry that for you?

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "-eyim" (kapatayım, açayım) eki çoğu zaman anlık kararı ya da teklifi gösterir ve İngilizcede "I'll ..." ile karşılanır. Restoranda sipariş verirken de will kullanılır: I'll have the fish, please (Ben balık alayım).

options: I'll fly to Ankara on Monday.
I'm going to fly to Ankara on Monday.

practice.text: This bag is heavy. – I'll ___ it for you. (carry)

practice.answer: I'll call you back in five minutes.
practice.translation: Beş dakika içinde seni geri arayacağım.

practice.audioText: I'm so tired and I haven't cooked anything. – Don't worry. I'll make dinner tonight. You sit down.

accepted: I'll close the window.
I'll close the window
I will close the window.
I will close the window
I'll shut the window.
I'll shut the window

task.prompt: JAI size sorunlar söyleyecek ("I'm hungry", "My car broke down", "I can't find my keys"). Her biri için will ile anlık bir teklif ya da karar söyleyin; en az birinde Shall I...? kullanın ve bir de söz verin.
task.modelAnswer: I'll make you a sandwich. ... I'll drive you to work. ... Shall I help you look for them? ... I promise I'll be on time tomorrow.

lessons.title: Gezegenimiz
lessons.goal: Çevre sorunları hakkında tahminlerde bulunup ne yapabileceğimizi tartışabilirim.

discover.title: Öğrenci kulübü posteri
discover.body:
SAVE OUR PLANET – What will happen if we don't act?

Scientists say temperatures will rise by 2°C or more. There will probably be more droughts in some countries and more floods in others. Some animals might disappear forever.

But it's not too late! Here's what we can do:
• Use less plastic. Take your own bag to the shop.
• Recycle paper, glass and plastic.
• Walk, cycle or use public transport.
• Switch off lights and devices when you don't use them.

Join our Green Club! We're going to clean the beach next Saturday. Will you help us?

questions.prompt: What might happen to some animals?
What is the Green Club going to do next Saturday?
questions.explanation: "We're going to clean the beach next Saturday."

learn.explanation:
Bu ünitede gördüğümüz gelecek yapılarının hepsi bir arada:

| Yapı | Kullanım | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| will | görüşe dayalı tahmin | Temperatures **will** rise. |
| might | olasılık | Some animals **might** disappear. |
| will | anlık karar / teklif | I**'ll** join the club! |
| going to | plan / niyet | We**'re going to** clean the beach. |
| going to | kanıta dayalı tahmin | Look at the smoke. There**'s going to** be a fire. |
| present continuous | ayarlanmış plan | We**'re meeting** at 9 on Saturday. |

**Görüş bildirmek:**

- I'm worried that ... (... diye endişeleniyorum)
- I'm sure ... will ... (... -eceğinden eminim)
- We need to ... / We should ...

examples.en: I'm worried that there won't be enough water.
I'm sure young people will make a difference.

learn.turkishNote: Hangi gelecek yapısını seçeceğinizden emin değilseniz şunu sorun: Bu bir plan mı (going to / present continuous), bir tahmin mi (will / might), yoksa şu an verdiğim bir karar mı (will)? "Make a difference" = fark yaratmak (do a difference değil).

options: We'll clean the beach next Saturday.
We're going to clean the beach next Saturday.
I'm joining the club since yesterday.

task.prompt: Okul ya da şehir dergisi için çevre hakkında kısa bir yazı yazın (80–100 kelime): 2 tahmin (will), 1 olasılık (might), 2 öneri (should / need to) ve sizin bir planınız (going to).
task.modelAnswer:
Our city in 2050
I think summers will be hotter and there will be less water. Some trees in our parks might die. But I'm sure we can change things. We should plant more trees and we need to use less water at home. We should also use public transport more. My friends and I are going to start a recycling project at our school next month. Will you join us?

options: I'm going to visit Rome in May.

questions.prompt: "Hayatım 10 yıl sonra" başlıklı kısa bir yazı yazın (80–100 kelime). will, won't, might, probably / definitely ve en az bir going to kullanın.
questions.modelAnswer:
My life in ten years
In ten years I'll be 38. I think I'll live in a small house near the sea. I'll definitely have a dog! I might have children, but I'm not sure yet. I probably won't work in an office; I'll work from home. I'll speak English very well because I'm going to study every day. Maybe I'll travel to Japan. I hope I'll be happy and healthy.
